title: Collectibles Advancments
description: Adds an advancement tab for collectors to complete item collections, like all Copper items or all Armor Templates.
body:
# 🏆 Collectibles Advancement Datapack 🏆

Add a **brand-new Advancement tab** for all the collectors out there! Perfect for players who LOVE gathering items – from **all Copper items 🪙**, **all Armor Trims 🛡️**, **all Sherds 🗿**, **all Mob Armors 🐉**, and more! Collect and complete your favorite item sets.  

## ✨ Features
- **📋 Organized Tab:** Track your collections clearly and easily.  
- **🎁 Rewards:** Currently gives **XP** for completed collections (more rewards coming in future updates!).  
- **🕵️ Collection Challenges:** Turn regular gameplay into a fun adventure!  
- **🌟 More Collections Coming:** New sets may be added in future updates!  
- **⚠️ Version Notice:** No backports are provided – updates and fixes are only for the **latest version**.
